atom_verbatim: A finding that is about part of an event, rather than the event as a whole, meets this criterion for the use of FA. An assessment of an event that is not about the whole of an event may be a "snapshot," an assessment at a point in time, or a "slice," an assessment over a period of time (i.e., evaluation interval) during the event. In Section 6.4.4., Findings About Events or Interventions, Example 1 shows snapshot assessments at 3 points in time. The timing variables used to represent a snapshot assessment generally include FADTC, along with visit and time point variables as applicable, but not FAEVLINT or FAEVINTX. FA Example 5 shows assessments over 24-hour slices of the event.
